Criteria for Approval:
• Patient has diagnosis of recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis with
≥ 3 episodes of vulvovaginal candidiasis in ≤ 12-month period;
AND

• Patient is a biological female who is postmenopausal or has
another reason for permanent infertility (e.g., tubal ligation,
hysterectomy, salpingo-oophorectomy); AND

• Patient has tried and failed or has a contraindication or
intolerance to maintenance antifungal therapy with oral
fluconazole for 6 months.
Quantity Limit: 18 tablets per treatment course
